description: young man cleric in a winter outfit for the old Slavic midwinter feast, calm, short fair hair, standing in the middle of the image, small full body figure from the top of the head to the feet, empty space above the head and below the feet, a long cream sheepskin coat down to the ankles with golden and red folk embroidery, a round white fur hat, a golden wool scarf, holding a staff topped with a small golden sun wreathed in fir branches, facing the viewer, three-quarter view, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy
